violated_contract: A destructive operation that already acted through a provider must not report success after a same-kind peer displaced its account-gate ownership at exit. The takeover must propagate to the caller, which must not count a delete it no longer owns or retry a finish with the displaced token.
canonical_prevention: Re-raise DestructiveGateTakeover before any broad exception handler in the destructive path. Keep read-path cleanup on the exclusive claim so a live owner is not displaced by a same-kind peer. Cover with a test where the exit raises the takeover after a successful provider call and asserts it propagates with no count returned.
